portfolio_rationale: The three strongest prior-trend groups (cyber, semis, momentum) suffered 6-9% one-week relative drawdowns with high-volume capitulation in cyber and no sector-specific negative news in the briefing, consistent with a rates-driven factor unwind that often partially retraces within a week. Edge is modest (55-58%), so these are mild overweights with wide ranges. Staples, oil, and dollar strength are rotation beneficiaries without independent in-window catalysts; Korea's weakness is persistent rather than a one-week shock; VTI and ARKQ offer no edge.
key_risks: Continued rate pressure after hot CPI/PPI keeps long-duration tech under pressure, extending the unwind into another week; Mega-cap tech earnings or AI-capex news inside the window could reprice semis and cyber sharply in either direction; High beta (1.5-2.3) of top picks means a further broad market decline would widen underperformance versus SPY; Defensive rotation into staples/value could persist, making the reversal call early
